About 30 m per pixel (38 m on this map),: Cishe amamitha angu-30 nge-pixel (amamitha angu-38 kule mephu), kusuka ekudluleni kwesathelayithi kosuku olulodwa: izingxenye zemephu azinalutho noma zinamafu, ngakho zama olunye usuku. Azicacile ngokwanele ukudweba ujantshi noma imiphetho yemigwaqo.
Satellite imagery from NASA's Global Ima: Izithombe zesathelayithi ezivela ku-Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS) ye-NASA njengamamephu ayisisekelo asemoyeni, osukwini olukhethayo: i-Harmonized Landsat Sentinel-2 cishe ngamamitha angu-30 nge-pixel ne-VIIRS cishe ngamamitha angu-250. Akudingeki ukhiye we-API. Izithombe azicacile ngokwanele ukubona imigwaqo noma ujantshi.
The whole world each day at about 250 m: Umhlaba wonke nsuku zonke cishe ngamamitha angu-250 nge-pixel (amamitha angu-306 kule mephu), namafu: okwesimo sesifunda kuphela.
